scientific_question: Can one globally shared observation subset, chosen only on frozen design families, make probe-relative stable relations broadly identifiable while every primary confirmation family retains several compatible dynamics and several full stable object relations?
interpretation_lock: This is an oracle experimental-design existence scout. The exact designer may use train-side stable relations. Success would not be spontaneous object discovery, learned perception, or semantic objecthood.
optimization_ceiling: The winner is exact only within each preregistered 32-subset shortlist. The cheap screen is exhaustive over all 2500 frozen candidates, but the result is not a global optimum of relation identifiability over those candidates or over all 65536 trajectory subsets.

parent.accepted_fact: The frozen cumulative hash-order packet has no admitted consensus-without-identification window.
parent.forbidden_search_input: No parent engine result or budget ledger may be read by a search or confirmation engine.

engine_contract.search_phase: JAX and Julia independently enumerate all cheap screens and exact-score the frozen shortlist using design fixtures only.
engine_contract.selection_controller: Compares complete score receipts and freezes all three size winners before any confirmation source exists.
engine_contract.confirmation_phase: New JAX and Julia sources may read only the frozen winner receipt, validation fixtures, and conditionally the reused test block.
engine_contract.pytorch: excluded: no learner is admissible in this target-aware design scout

inherited_carrier.query_definition: all 9636 unordered distinct state pairs with equal initial probe
inherited_carrier.stable_relation: exact behavioral equivalence under both candidate actions and the fixed probe

rule_family_split.design_fixture_selection: Order the 2880 train pair-orbit representatives by SHA256('ECA-OBS-DESIGN-V1|design_fixture|a,b'), tie by pair, and take the first 128.
rule_family_split.secondary_confirmation: the 531 v0 test representatives are historically consumed and may be reported only when the validation robustness gate passes; they cannot authorize learning

candidate_pool.unit: all four action-labelled transitions from one frozen (word,initial_state) trajectory
candidate_pool.globality: the same unordered subset of candidate indices is used for every fixture and query

two_stage_search.shortlist_completeness: exactly 32 unique subsets per size, in screen rank order
exact_metrics: three-valued relation vector over all 9636 queries
query-disjoint relation vector excluding states observed as predecessors or successors
two_stage_search.robust_query_count: identifiable_query_count when the fixture satisfies diversity_fixture, otherwise zero
exact_objective_lexicographic_max: count design fixtures with identifiable-same and identifiable-different each at least 10 percent of identifiable queries
two_stage_search.outputs: one immutable screened-set winner S2, S3, and S4 plus hashes of all 2500 screen records and all 96 exact-score records

baselines.hash_order: first k candidate indices in the inherited candidate order
baselines.system_identification_maximizer: same exhaustive subsets and design fixtures; lexicographically minimize total ordered version-space size, then maximize system-identified fixture count, tie by candidate-index tuple
baselines.required_comparison: relation-directed winners, hash-order subsets, and system-identification winners are evaluated at identical sizes and on identical confirmation fixtures

primary_validation_gate.construction: every true pair remains in a nonempty version space
primary_validation_gate.diversity: every one of the 325 validation fixtures retains at least eight effective unordered hypotheses and at least two distinct full partition relations
primary_validation_gate.system_identification: zero validation fixtures have singleton ordered version spaces
primary_validation_gate.global_relation_coverage: at least 95 percent of all validation queries are identifiable
primary_validation_gate.fixture_floor: every validation fixture has at least 80 percent identifiable queries
primary_validation_gate.query_disjoint_global_coverage: at least 90 percent of query-disjoint validation queries are identifiable
primary_validation_gate.query_disjoint_fixture_floor: every validation fixture has at least 70 percent identifiable query-disjoint queries
primary_validation_gate.pooled_target_balance: identifiable-same and identifiable-different each comprise at least 20 percent of consensus queries
primary_validation_gate.fixture_balance: at least 80 percent of validation fixtures have identifiable-same and identifiable-different each at least 10 percent of their identifiable queries
primary_validation_gate.baseline_separation: the relation-directed winner must strictly exceed hash-order minimum robust coverage or sum robust coverage, and must retain more diversity than the system-identification winner
primary_validation_gate.candidate_exists: at least one of S2, S3, S4 passes every primary validation condition
primary_validation_gate.robust_design_family: at least two of S2, S3, S4 pass every primary validation condition

confirmation_policy.test_gate: same per-fixture conditions as primary validation across all 531 reused test fixtures
confirmation_policy.failure_behavior: if fewer than two sizes pass validation, test remains unopened and the scout closes red

query_leakage_controls.query_disjoint_definition: neither query state appears as an observed predecessor or successor in the selected packet for that fixture

required_controls: all 96 shortlisted subsets exact-scored exactly once
omitted subset changes completeness hash and fails
winner-index or winner-hash mutation fails selection controller
search engines read no validation, test, parent engine, or peer result
confirmation sources are historically absent when winner receipt freezes
factorized compatible-rule construction matches ordered brute force on boundary winners
action-token swap preserves unordered relation vectors
hash-order and system-identification baselines run at every size
all selected sizes remain visible even when one fails
blocked_consumers: spontaneous object discovery or object creation
QIT stages, four substages, or the 16-by-4-by-2 schedule
MMMs, ontology admission, universal attractor, Axis0, physics, life, or consciousness
